title: Tracking a Small Set of Experts in Online Convex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.20416v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: For the fundamental problem of prediction from expert advice, Freund asked whether one could compete with a comparator that switches $k$ times among only $m$ experts. For a discrete set of experts, this problem was resolved by Bousquet and Warmuth (2020), who gave an efficient algorithm with optimal regret matching the information-theoretic limit.   We study the analogous problem in online convex optimization, where the action space is continuous. An inefficient algorithm can be derived by discretizing the action space and applying the Bousquet--Warmuth algorithm, giving regret of $\widetilde{O}(md+k)$, while the best known efficient algorithm for this problem has regret $\widetilde{O}(dk)$. translated_title: 在线凸优化中追踪一小组专家
translated_abstract: 对于从专家建议中进行预测这一基本问题，Freund 曾提出疑问：算法能否与一个仅在 $m$ 位专家之间切换 $k$ 次的比较对象相竞争。对于离散的专家集合，Bousquet 和 Warmuth（2020）解决了这一问题，他们给出了一个高效算法，其遗憾度达到了信息论极限。我们在在线凸优化中研究类似的问题，此时动作空间是连续的。通过将动作空间离散化并应用 Bousquet–Warmuth 算法，可以导出一个低效的算法，其遗憾度为 $\widetilde{O}(md+k)$，而目前已知的针对该问题的最佳高效算法遗憾度为 $\widetilde{O}(dk)$。我们证明了这种计算上的低效是该问题所固有的，从而为该问题建立了信息论遗憾界与多项式时间可达遗憾界之间的分离。具体而言，在超图植入团猜想（hypergraphic planted-clique conjecture）之下，我们证明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了在线凸优化中“追踪一小组专家”问题存在本质的计算复杂性分离：信息论上可达的最优遗憾度 $\widetilde{O}(md+k)$ 在超图植入团猜想等复杂性假设下无法被任何多项式时间算法实现，高效算法只能达到 $\widetilde{O}(dk)$ 量级的遗憾度。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an inherent separation between the information-theoretically optimal regret and the regret achievable by polynomial-time algorithms for tracking a small set of experts in online convex optimization.
